mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 6.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicates strengthening consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above 3-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both exceed their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0% for 3 months), the increased cost of capital reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO exceeds its 6-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 900 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that depresses consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST falls below 900 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) above their 3-month moving averages indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS above 3-month moving average and UNRATE below 3-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS rises above its 3-month moving average and UNRATE falls below its 3-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising retail sales (RSAFS) with year-over-year growth exceeding 4% signals robust consumer demand that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS YoY growth exceeds 4% during a late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
